name: hash-xx-short
algorithm: std XXH3-64 (seed 0) over every 16-byte key of splitmix64 bytes, reps passes with a one-byte write-back (mk/hash-xx-short.mk).

skip.c: no std hash: C has no standard XXH3
skip.rust: no std XXH3: Rust std has none (only SipHash-1-3 in DefaultHasher); no crate stands in
skip.go: no std XXH3: Go std has none (hash/maphash is a different, seeded hash); no module stands in

notes: Idiomatic standard library, the short-key (hash table) case: hashes per second = mib * 1048576 / 16 * reps / median.
